outputs: free-text explanations for justifying action selections
The generated outputs include selected actions (Level-1) and generated reasons (Level-2) to justify the action selection in vision-grounded decision-making scenarios.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate 'reason generation' tasks, normalized model names to standard forms, and refined output descriptions to be more precise about the three types of outputs evaluated.
Removed ChatGPT-based scores as they are LLM-as-judge metrics (covered in Q3), not traditional automatic metrics. Kept Accuracy, BERTScore, and BLEURT as core automatic evaluation metrics.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate method descriptions and kept the criteria explicitly mentioned in the evaluation prompt (quality, relevance, accuracy, coverage of key points).
No human evaluation of generated outputs was conducted in this paper. The human annotations were for dataset construction, not for evaluating model outputs.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating vision-language models' ability to generate explanations/reasons for their decisions in vision-grounded scenarios. While it uses automatic metrics and LLM-as-judge, it does not conduct human evaluation of the generated outputs. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and consolidation of duplicate entries.
